name: Hefang Street
bio_draft: Wikivoyage Hangzhou describes Hefang Jie at the base of Wushan as a pedestrian old street of stalls and small lanes; open daily, a visitor strolls it for an hour. Source: https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Hangzhou

name: Flower Pond Fish Viewing
bio_draft: Wikivoyage Hangzhou lists Viewing Fish at Flower Pond among the Ten Scenes with its own point; a garden park with koi ponds visitors walk through. Source: https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Hangzhou
